name: Userback
description: Access feedback, technical details, summarize reports, and decide what needs attention next directly from Claude. Empower product, engineering, and support teams to quickly and easily diagnose and analyze customer feedback, identify patterns, and keep work moving by creating, updating, and commenting on feedback items directly from their AI workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Userback to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Userback to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.userback.io/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Userback MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Userback provides these MCP tools: add_feedback, add_feedback_comment, get_feedback, get_feedback_logs, list_account_users, list_projects, list_workflows, search_feedback_filter, search_feedback_semantic, set_feedback_assignee, set_feedback_workflow, and update_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Userback?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Userback in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.
Userback requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Userback is developed by Userback. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
